_comment: Octail's own egg (no upstream file). Robust.Server (the Space Station 14 server) for linux-x64 from the official build manifest (wizards.cdn.spacestation14.com, or a fork's manifest), checked against the SHA-256 the manifest lists for that build, failures exit non-zero. The build is framework-dependent .NET 10, so it runs on dotnet_10 (DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major lets an older .NET build start there too). server_config.toml (TOML, edited with the ini parser: sections and key=value) gets the port, the IPv4 bind, name, description, soft player cap, hub listing, local-login off and the host user before every start; the database and the rest stay in data/. The start is the game ticker's first round restart or the status API's TCP port once bound; the stop is SIGTERM: .NET turns it into ProcessExit, which Robust answers with a clean Shutdown("ProcessExited") (it allows itself 10 s). Ctrl+C (SIGINT) only reaches Robust's CancelKeyPress hook, which it sets up in interactive (TTY) console mode; on node1 the server did not stop within 120 s with it and its console printed Toolshed's help instead, and the shutdown console command without a reason crashed (2026-10-13).
name: Space Station 14
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Space Station 14, the open-source remake of Space Station 13: a round-based roleplay game about a space station crew. Runs the official Robust.Server build from the Space Wizards CDN (or a fork's).
startup: DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major exec dotnet Robust.Server.dll --config-file server_config.toml --data-dir data

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Space Station 14 (Octail's own install script): Robust.Server for linux-x64 from the build manifest of the official
# Wizard's Den CDN (or a fork's manifest), checked against the SHA-256 the manifest lists, failures exit non-zero.
# server_config.toml (the sample in the build) is only written when there is none; data/ (the SQLite database,
# preferences, bans) is never touched.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail
# Downloads are staged on the server disk: the install container's /tmp is a small tmpfs.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.octail-install
trap 'rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install' EXIT
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq unzip ca-certificates > /dev/null

MANIFEST="${SS14_MANIFEST:-https://wizards.cdn.spacestation14.com/fork/wizards/manifest}"
BUILD="${SS14_BUILD:-latest}"

if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 120 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-manifest.json "$MANIFEST"; then
    echo "Installation failed: the build manifest ${MANIFEST} couldn't be read."
    exit 1
fi
if [ "$BUILD" = "latest" ]; then
    # The newest build (by its time) that has a linux-x64 server.
    BUILD=$(jq -r '[.builds | to_entries[] | select(.value.server["linux-x64"].url != null)] | max_by(.value.time) | .key // empty' /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-manifest.json)
fi
URL=$(jq -r --arg b "$BUILD" '.builds[$b].server["linux-x64"].url // empty' /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-manifest.json)
SUM=$(jq -r --arg b "$BUILD" '.builds[$b].server["linux-x64"].sha256 // empty' /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-manifest.json | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
if [ -z "$BUILD" ] || [ -z "$URL" ] || [ -z "$SUM" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: build ${BUILD:-latest} has no linux-x64 server with a checksum in ${MANIFEST}."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloading Space Station 14 build ${BUILD} from ${URL}"
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 900 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors -o /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server.zip "$URL"
if ! echo "${SUM}  /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server.zip" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    rm -f /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server.zip
    echo "Installation failed: the download doesn't match the manifest's SHA-256."
    exit 1
fi
rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server
unzip -q -o /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server.zip -d /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server </dev/null
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server/Robust.Server.dll ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: the build has no Robust.Server.dll."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
# The owner's config stays; a new build's prototypes replace the old ones completely (no stale files).
if [ -f server_config.toml ]; then
    rm -f /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server/server_config.toml
fi
rm -rf Resources
cp -a /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server/. /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-server.zip /mnt/server/.octail-install/ss14-manifest.json
chmod +x Robust.Server 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p data
echo "$BUILD" > .ss14-build

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/Robust.Server.dll ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: Robust.Server.dll is missing."
    exit 1
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: Space Station 14 build ${BUILD}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name in the server list and the lobby (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Description
variables.description: Shown in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The player cap shown in the server list (admins can still join above it).

variables.name: List on the hub
variables.description: true lists the server on the public hub (read and follow the Space Wizards hub rules first); false: players join by address (ss14://host:port).

variables.name: Host user
variables.description: A Space Station 14 account name that gets full admin rights when it joins, to set up the first admins in game. Empty: nobody. Clear it once permanent admins are set.

variables.name: Build
variables.description: latest (the newest build in the manifest) or a build id from it (the commit hash). Reinstall to switch.

variables.name: Build manifest
variables.description: The build manifest to install from: the official Wizard's Den one, or a fork's (https://<cdn>/fork/<fork>/manifest). Reinstall to switch.
